item.title: POV: You found the perfect Christmas getaway for your husband
item.description: Tammin Sursok finds a beautiful glass cabin with stunning views for a Christmas getaway. There's just one catch: the entire cabin is basically a toilet, making it perfect for her husband.

item.title: What Searching Online With OCD Can Look Like
item.description: A small health concern turns into a long internet search involving Reddit, Google, ChatGPT, and TikTok. This skit humorously depicts the cycle of health-related anxiety and reassurance seeking.
